title: Reporting, Evaluating, Preventing and Treating the Cardiotoxicity Induced by Anticancer Drugs During a Specific Cardio-oncology Consult and Follow up in Routine Care
official: Reporting, Evaluating, Preventing and Treating the Cardiotoxicity Induced by Anticancer Drugs During a Specific Cardio-oncology Consult and Follow up in Routine Care
summary: Several Drugs used in routine care in oncology induce rare but often severe or fatal cardiovascular or metabolic side effects. This study will investigate, evaluate, report and treat the cardiovascular side effects of anticancer drugs, through a specific cardiovascular routine checkup and follow-up taking place in several Cardio-oncology programs throughout France. The different including centers will be: Assistance Publique - Hôpitaux de Paris (APHP.6: Pitié-Salpétrière, Saint Antoine and Tenon's hospitals, Paris, France).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Suffering a cancer
* Evaluated within a cardio-oncology program

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
